revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and a couple of schema-citation misapplications need correction before this ships: (1) Fix script_coverage[11] appointment_set ts -- the 'Please send me my email' customer quote is at 03:34-03:37, not 03:05 (03:05 is where the rep starts the appointment-setting pitch); either change the quote at 03:05 to the rep's actual line, or move 'Please send me my email' to its correct timestamp and pull a different anchor quote for the 03:05 entry. (2) Re-anchor cherry_pick_moments[1] (01:52 knowledge_gap) to a more appropriate schema reference than coaching_philosophy.energy_match, which is about pace/tone matching, not comprehension-breakdown handling -- either cite analysis_directives.knowledge_gap_handling/tech_friction_handling or explicitly flag this as a schema gap (no dedicated language-barrier protocol exists yet). (3) Revisit cherry_pick_moments[0] intro critique -- intros.standard's actual success signals include reference_to_form_submission, which the rep satisfied; don't fault the rep for missing a state-mention requirement that belongs to intros.tesla, not intros.standard. (4) Add a standalone cherry_pick_moment or strengthen trajectory_verdict.shape to flag the appointment as conditional/fragile given the customer's repeated, unresolved insistence on written price/contract confirmation through 04:47 -- this is exactly the conditional_booking_detection pattern the schema calls for and it's currently only implicit in multi_touch_patterns and handoff_brief. (5) Correct objections[0].rep_attempts count from 2 to include the additional rep restatement at 04:52 ('I'll make sure we show you the price right away'), which is a third handling attempt of the same email/price objection.
